name: SectionMessage
intent: Carry a section-level status - information, success, warning, or error - with an optional title, description, actions, and dismiss.

figmaSource.notes: Figma boolean properties (title, actions, isDismissible) map to optional props in code (title/actions omitted to hide; isDismissible defaults false). The Figma `discovery` tone was removed by the designer; code ships information/success/warning/error. Actions are Link Button instances laid out in a Button Group (the designer replaced the earlier middot-separated Links with a button-group instance; verified 2026-09-09).

useCases: communicate a permission or access restriction inside a section
warn about the state of a section or form
summarize a failed submit at the top of a form, linking to each field that needs fixing
antiPatterns: inline status next to a single field or row

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: bordered, rounded box with the tone's tinted background and colored border

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: the status icon for the tone, in its status color; decorative

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: the children; wraps to multiple lines (body-md). Required unless errors is set

anatomy.name: errors
anatomy.description: optional list from errors: one bulleted line per field, a Link to #targetId then what to do

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: optional actions (typically Link Buttons), laid out by a ButtonGroup the caller passes; no separators are injected

anatomy.name: dismiss
anatomy.description: optional dismiss IconButton (xs, subtle) in the top-right

statusLabel.default: the tone's name (Information, Success, Warning, Error)
statusLabel.description: Visually hidden text read before the message, since the status icon is decorative. An empty string omits it.

title.description: Optional bold title above the description.

children.description: The description. Wraps to multiple lines. Required unless errors lists what's wrong.

errors.type: Array<{ label: React.ReactNode; message?: React.ReactNode; targetId: string }>
errors.description: The fields that need fixing, for a form's summary after a failed submit. Listed under the description; each label is a Link to #targetId that moves focus to the control (or the first control inside a target that can't take focus).

actions.description: Optional actions (typically Link Buttons). Wrap multiple in a ButtonGroup, which lays them out as a row; a single action can be passed bare.

dismissLabel.description: Accessible name for the dismiss button.

onDismiss.description: Called when dismissed. The message also hides itself.

role.description: Overridable ARIA role - e.g. alert for urgent errors.

slots.name: actions
slots.allowedContent: React.ReactNode (typically a ButtonGroup of LinkButton elements)

spacing.actionsGap: --spacing-sm (the ButtonGroup between the actions owns this; the .actions wrapper matches it for bare actions)

accessibility.statusAnnounced: Visually hidden statusLabel before the title.
accessibility.errorsList: errors renders a ul; each link moves focus to its control (or the first control inside it) and prevents the in-page jump.

behaviorRules: Set the tinted background, border color, and status icon from tone.
Render the icon in its own status color (not inherited).
Render the title only when provided.
Wrap the description across multiple lines (no truncation).
Render the errors list (when it has entries) after the description; each label links to #targetId and, on click, focuses that control or the first control inside it.
Render the actions region (which holds the caller's actions, laid out by their ButtonGroup) only when actions are provided; do not inject separators.
Show the dismiss button only when isDismissible is true; on dismiss, hide the message and call onDismiss.
Default role to status (a polite live region); allow it to be overridden.
Mark the status icon aria-hidden and label the dismiss button.
compositionRules: Wrap multiple actions in a ButtonGroup of LinkButtons; a single action can be passed bare.
Keep actions to a small number of related links.
Use Banner, Toast, or InlineMessage for the non-section-level cases.
contentRules: Lead with the essential status in the title or first sentence.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate the tone.
Reserve dismiss for messages the user can safely make go away.
themeRules: Use theme CSS variables for all color values.
Do not use primitive color tokens directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: Reuse the StatusIcon set and the atoms Link / LinkButton / IconButton; lay actions out with ButtonGroup.
do: Use Section Message for a contained, in-context status.
Use tone to signal the semantic status.
Wrap multiple actions in a ButtonGroup of Link Buttons; pass a single action bare.
Use a title for a scannable lead when the message is longer.
List the fields a failed submit needs fixed in errors, in the order of the form.
dont: Do not use Section Message for page-level or transient messages.
Do not rely on color alone to convey meaning.
Do not make a persistent constraint dismissible.
Do not hardcode colors, spacing, or typography.
Do not hand-lay a list of links in the description; use errors, which moves focus to each field.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders the title when provided and omits it otherwise.
Defaults to role status and the information tone.
Supports tones information, success, warning, error.
Renders the passed actions (no injected separators) and omits the region when none.
Is not dismissible by default; dismisses and calls onDismiss when the dismiss button is clicked.
Lists errors after the description as links that move focus to each control.
Allows the role to be overridden.
Forwards the ref to the root element.
Uses semantic spacing, typography, border, and color tokens.
